title: About Our Agency
content:
Welcome to Top Mountain Treks Pvt. Ltd.

Headquartered in Thamel, Kathmandu, we are an approved local mountaineering operator registered with the Ministry of Tourism, TAAN, and NMA. Since 2010, we have guided thousands of high-altitude trekkers safely across the Himalayas.

title: Why Travel With Us?
content:
Why Choose Top Mountain Treks?

When you embark on a high-altitude adventure in the Himalayas, your safety, experience, and comfort depend entirely on the team you choose. Here is why thousands of adventurers choose us:

  • 100% Local Expertise: Owned and operated by experienced mountain guides born in the Everest and Annapurna regions.
  • Safety First: We carry oxygen chambers, sat-phones, and comprehensive medical kits on all high-altitude trips.
  • Transparent Pricing: No hidden costs, local taxes, or surprise fees. What you book is what you pay.
  • Sustainable Tourism: We support local schools, pay fair wages to our porters, and follow strict Leave No Trace guidelines.

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
Terms & Booking Policy

Please review our booking requirements and policies below:

  1. Deposit Requirements: A non-refundable 20% deposit is required at the time of booking to secure your permits, flights, and lodge reservations.
  2. Cancellation Policy: Cancellations made 30 days or more before the departure date will lose the deposit. Cancellations within 14 days of departure are subject to 100% cancellation fee.
  3. Mandatory Insurance: All travelers must have comprehensive travel insurance covering emergency helicopter evacuation up to 6,000 meters.

title: Awards and Achievements
content:
Our Awards & Sustainable Certifications

Through our commitment to quality service and eco-friendly trekking, we have received multiple national and international recognitions:

  • TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence (2018 - 2025): Awarded for consistently receiving five-star traveler feedback.
  • Eco-Trekking Partner (TAAN): Certified for our plastic-free camping and environment preservation initiatives in national parks.
  • Nepal Tourism Board Excellence Award (2022): Recognized for outstanding contribution to safe high-altitude trekking.
